questions.stem: According to the passage, software architecture primarily refers to （）.
options: the programming languages used to build the system
the fundamental organization of a system including its components and their relationships
the detailed design of each software module
the testing strategy for the software system
questions.explanation: 文章第一句明确指出："Software architecture is the fundamental organization of a system, embodied in its components, their relationships to each other and to the environment"。软件架构指系统的基本组织结构，包括组件及其关系。
questions.id: 架构-专业英语-2026年5月-模拟卷4#1

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as a quality attribute?
questions.explanation: 文中提到的质量属性包括performance（性能）、security（安全性）、availability（可用性）和modifiability（可修改性）。Usability（易用性）在文中没有提到。
questions.id: 架构-专业英语-2026年5月-模拟卷4#2

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the trend in modern software architecture?
options: Moving from distributed systems back to monolithic designs
Shifting from monolithic designs to distributed systems with independent scalability
Eliminating the need for architecture evaluation
questions.explanation: 文中最后一段描述："The rise of cloud computing and microservices has shifted the focus from monolithic designs to distributed systems that can scale independently"，现代架构趋势是从单体设计转向可独立扩展的分布式系统。
questions.id: 架构-专业英语-2026年5月-模拟卷4#3
